errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such repository, or this appview keeps no index, so it keeps no steps.

q.description: Only steps whose name starts with this.

repo.description: Only the steps of this repository, by its dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle.

main.description: The shared steps the appview has indexed, from dev.knotless.release records of packages named `@step/<name>` whose one file is a step file, each at its latest version, in the order of their names: everyone's, one repository's, or those whose name starts with `q`. A step of an account, repository or release taken down is left out. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

description: The shared steps repositories publish, for workflows to use.
